answers.falsifier: Done when the proof reads 7 of 7 green over the live repo at 0 breaches, and when the planted tooth goes red if either reader misses the planted edge or reports the published-tool reach. Wrong intent if a live cross-device reach exists that both readers miss alike, which an equality check cannot see in any version.
answers.how: Lift the tooth's independent path census into a helper over any root. A new tooth plants a fixture repo with one reach into a device's internals (one row) and one reach into a tool that device publishes (no row), and asserts the census and encapsulation_breaches both read exactly that one row. The live tooth keeps its equality but drops the non-empty assertion.
answers.traces_to: Law 9 (red is distance from the spec): the tooth reds the very state RULE 1 closes toward, so its red measures nothing about the spec. Law 8: the non-vacuity guard must stay, so that a hollow inspector cannot pass by reading nothing; a planted edge keeps it without depending on live debt.
answers.what: test_encapsulation_holds' live-census tooth stays green when the live repo has no cross-device reach left, and its guard against a vacuous match is a planted edge both readers must find.
